Lemma
[First variation of map energy (Lemma K.14)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0360, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0361 ↗ def:chow-iv-k10-map-energy 1. appk:K.14\group Harmonic Maps

For a variation with field $V=\partial _sf_s|_{s=0}$, \[ \left.\frac{d}{ds}\right|_{0}E_{g,h}(f_s)= 2\int _{\mathcal M}\langle \nabla ^{f^*h}V,df\rangle \, d\mu _g =-2\int _{\mathcal M}\langle V,\Delta _{g,h}f\rangle \, d\mu _g \] when $V$ is compactly supported in the interior (or under the corresponding boundary conditions). Thus harmonic maps are critical points.
